mechanism: Meprobamate may potentiate the hypoglycemic effects of pioglitazone and increase CNS depression risk; pioglitazone metabolism via CYP2C8 may be affected by meprobamate's enzyme-inducing properties.
action: Monitor blood glucose levels closely and assess for hypoglycemic symptoms; evaluate need for pioglitazone dose adjustment; counsel patient on CNS depression risks and avoid concurrent use if alternative anxiolytic available.
